name: Unknown Code
source:
Because of an accident, you came to a certain tribe. You need to solve what happened here and find a way home.

[From [url=https://kadzuart.itch.io/unknowncode]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一次意外过后，你来到某个部落。你需要查清这里究竟发生了什么，再找到回家的路。

〔摘自[url=https://kadzuart.itch.io/unknowncode]itch.io[/url]〕
